title: Kanban config cannot hide an always-empty lane or choose its lanes
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27386 said: take what is ui-only, card the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` (report 6518223407, `out_of_scope_findings`). Rows 2 and 4 are taken in PR #28017.
Reach: any board grouped on a select field whose view filter keeps an option empty. HotCRM's Task Board always shows an empty Completed lane (#27386 row 1).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (the config key), then `domain:ui` (plugin-kanban's lane builder).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "kanban hide empty lanes choose lane list hideEmptyLanes" → #13692 (fallback lane for empty values, closed) and #27099 (drop-blocked lane), neither this.

## Observed
`KanbanConfigSchema` declares `groupByField`, `summarizeField`, `titleField` and `columns` only. A board grouped on a select field draws one lane per option, including a lane the view's own filter always keeps empty.

## Wanted
- **Spec:** a lane key on the kanban config: an ordered lane list (the option values to draw, in order), or a boolean `hideEmptyLanes`. Landing: `packages/spec` `ui/view.zod.ts` `KanbanConfigSchema`.
- **Console:** `ui/packages/plugin-kanban`'s lane builder reads it. The spec half lands first.

Dedupe words: kanban hideEmptyLanes, kanban lane list, kanban empty column hide.

Related: #27386 (row 1).
